lastCompletedStory.title: Fix claude-off-PATH regression in worker Dockerfile (US-003)

openQuestions: This was a reviewer-filed regression fix (round 3 finding): US-003's switch from apt-installed Node to a nodejs.org tarball moved npm's global-bin dir to /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin, so the later 'npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code' line landed claude off PATH. Fix applied exactly as the story's notes prescribed: an 'ENV PATH=/usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin:$PATH' line placed immediately after the claude-code npm install RUN step (not the symlink alternative), so any future npm global-bin package also resolves.

Per the story description, this fix is 'not catchable by the Docker-less CI suite; verified by the orchestrator against a real container build'. The machine gate (file-assert grep oracle, typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all) all passed cleanly in this sandbox (no docker daemon available here), but the empirical confirmation ('docker build + docker exec cam-worker command -v claude' resolving to /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin/claude) is host-verification left to the orchestrator per the story's own text, same pattern as US-R3-001's build-checks verification.

scripts/cam/project.toml's [loop].worker_isolation was already changed from 'container' to 'host' in the working tree before this story started (pre-existing dirty state at session start, not authored by this story). Left untouched and committed as-is since AGENT.md step 3/8 says commit ALL changes; not a regression I introduced or reverted. If this was an interim workaround for the exact claude-off-PATH bug just fixed here, the orchestrator may want to flip worker_isolation back to 'container' now that the regression is fixed, but that decision is out of scope for this story (notes say 'Do NOT touch any other file').

scripts/cam/prd.json's review block (roundsCompleted 2->3, maxRounds 3->5, autoShipDispatchedAt reset to null) was also already modified in the working tree before this story started (the review round that filed US-R3-002). Not touched further by this story beyond flipping US-R3-002.passes to true.
No non-operator stories with passes:false remain in prd.json after this story (verified via jq select query). The review cycle should now run to a terminal verdict via the sidecar.

officialDocsValidated.lib: npm (global bin resolution under a custom prefix)
officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed via WebFetch against docs.npmjs.com that npm's documented behavior is 'bin files are linked to {prefix}/bin': with the tarball-installed Node.js prefix set to /usr/local/lib/nodejs (this Dockerfile's layout), globally-installed CLI binaries (including claude-code's bin script) land at /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin, not /usr/local/bin. This confirms the root cause named in the story and validates that prepending /usr/local/lib/nodejs/bin to PATH (the fix applied) is the correct, documented resolution.
